A Christmas Carol

Annotated, with Original Illustrations from the 1843 Edition

Ebenezer Scrooge hates Christmas, until three ghosts take him through his past, present and future. Dickens first published this short ghost story in 1843, and it has been read every December since.

This annotated edition adds notes that explain the Victorian world behind the story, so the jokes, the money and the customs all make sense.

Questions

What does annotated mean?

The book includes extra notes alongside the story, such as explanations of the history and customs that a modern reader might not know.

Who wrote it?

Charles Dickens. The text is his complete original story.
